search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: G.Cot-38 (Gujarat Cotton-38, GJHV-497), Cotton (Gossypium hirsutum)

Name note: the CSC minutes name is "G.Cot-38". The Seednet name is "G.Cot-38 (Gujarat Cotton-38) (GJHV-497)". The JAU sources use "Gujarat Cotton 38 (G.Cot 38)" and cite GJHV-497 as its germplasm accession. Every finding below refers to this variety under one of these names. Search 4 (seed) returned only unrelated products.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- No drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence data for G.Cot-38 were found. The release recommendation covers irrigated conditions only (non-Bt cotton under irrigation) -- https://www.jau.in/storage/document/dynamic_document//research_accomplishments_and_recommendations_2019_20251219_760.pdf

DISEASE AND PEST
- Jassid: a rainfed screen of cotton genotypes lists GJHV-497 with a count of 6.0 jassids per 3 leaves per plant. The paper states that none of the 13 entries was rated resistant, and the snippet does not give GJHV-497's category -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/377961486_Evaluation_of_Cotton_Gossypium_hirsutum_L_VarietiesGenotypes_for_Jassid_Amrasca_biguttula_biguttula_Ishida_Resistance_under_Rainfed_Conditions
- No bacterial blight, wilt, or other disease rating for G.Cot-38 was found. The JAU station mandate names jassid and bacterial blight resistance as breeding goals, but it does not say G.Cot-38 carries them -- https://www.jau.in/index.php/component/content/article/2-init-content/research/100-cotton-research-station

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Seed cotton yield 2315 kg/ha, 9.0 to 28.1% above checks G.Cot-18, G.Cot-20, GN.Cot-22 and CNHO-12 -- https://www.jau.in/storage/document/dynamic_document//15th_agresco_proceeding_20251226_770.pdf
- Lint yield 767 kg/ha, 6.0 to 27.5% above the same checks. Ginning outturn 33.1%, oil 19.2%. Medium-late maturity -- https://www.jau.in/storage/document/dynamic_document//research_accomplishments_and_recommendations_2019_20251219_760.pdf
- Release sheet: plant height 122 cm, days to flowering 78, 46.7 bolls per plant, boll weight 3.6 g -- http://old.jau.in/attachments/New%20Variety%20Release/DCashCrops.pdf
- Release sheet agronomy: sowing 15 June to 10 July, 120 x 45 cm spacing, seed rate 5-7 kg/ha, N:P:K 160:0:120 kg/ha. The sheet's layout makes it unclear whether these lines belong to G.Cot-38 or to a preceding entry -- http://old.jau.in/attachments/New%20Variety%20Release/DCashCrops.pdf
- Fibre quality and multi-location trial data beyond the above were not found.

GENETICS AND QTL (genes, parentage, breeding-line codes, breeding method, genome resources)
- Parentage GJHV-34 x GJHV-14 (the input listed parentage as "Not specified"; the JAU release sheet supplies it) -- http://old.jau.in/attachments/New%20Variety%20Release/DCashCrops.pdf
- Breeding method: hybridization followed by pedigree selection -- http://old.jau.in/attachments/New%20Variety%20Release/DCashCrops.pdf
- Breeding-line code GJHV-497, NBPGR germplasm accession IC 627758 -- http://old.jau.in/attachments/New%20Variety%20Release/DCashCrops.pdf
- No QTL, marker, or genome data were found.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Developing institution: Junagadh Agricultural University, Cotton Research Station, Junagadh (Gujarat). The station was established in 1962 -- https://www.jau.in/cotton-research-station-junagadh
- Release submitted by Junagadh Agricultural University (release date 2018-19; gazette S.O. 01/04/2019) -- http://old.jau.in/attachments/New%20Variety%20Release/DCashCrops.pdf
- Recommendation credited to the Department of Genetics & Plant Breeding, JAU, Junagadh -- https://www.jau.in/storage/document/dynamic_document//research_accomplishments_and_recommendations_2019_20251219_760.pdf
- Lead breeder name for G.Cot-38: No evidence found. Dr. M. G. Valu is listed as Research Scientist (Cotton) and Unit Head of the station, but no page links him to this variety, so he is not recorded as breeder -- https://www.jau.in/cotton-research-station-junagadh

CONTACT DETAILS
- Cotton Research Station, Junagadh Agricultural University, Junagadh - 362001 (Gujarat) -- https://www.jau.in/cotton-research-station-junagadh
- Station phone as listed: (0285) 2674150; PBX 2672080-90 Ext. (the listing names Dr. M. G. Valu as Research Scientist (Cotton) & Unit Head, Specialization Genetics & Plant Breeding; this is a station contact, not a breeder contact for G.Cot-38) -- https://www.jau.in/cotton-research-station-junagadh
- University postal address as listed: Junagadh Agricultural University, Junagadh 362 001, Gujarat (INDIA) -- https://www.jau.in/cotton-research-station-khapat
- Email: No evidence found

PUBLICATIONS
- Author not stated (2019). Research Accomplishments and Recommendations 2019. Junagadh Agricultural University, Directorate of Research -- https://www.jau.in/storage/document/dynamic_document//research_accomplishments_and_recommendations_2019_20251219_760.pdf
- Author not stated (2025). 15th AGRESCO Proceedings (Combined Joint AGRESCO Meeting), G.Cot-38 entry 15.1.1.26. Anand Agricultural University (organizer) -- https://www.jau.in/storage/document/dynamic_document//15th_agresco_proceeding_20251226_770.pdf
- Author not stated (n.d.). New varieties/hybrids released by JAU 2004-05 to 2019-20, listing G.Cot 38 (state and national release). Junagadh Agricultural University -- http://old.jau.in/attachments/New%20Variety%20Release/GSummary.pdf
- Peer-reviewed or thesis papers on G.Cot-38: No evidence found
- KrishiKosh theses: No evidence found

SEED AVAILABILITY
- No evidence found. Gujarat State Seeds Corporation's cotton listing covers hybrids only and does not include G.Cot-38 -- http://www.gurabini.com/cropDetails.aspx?id=7
- The other seed search results are for unrelated products (Shriram-38, a Vinayak Seeds hybrid, and mandi prices) and were discarded. Searches did not reach the JAU or SAU seed-sale pages.

RECOMMENDED STATES
- Gujarat: recommended for irrigated non-Bt cotton, 2018-19 -- https://www.jau.in/storage/document/dynamic_document//research_accomplishments_and_recommendations_2019_20251219_760.pdf
- Irrigated areas of Central Zone Gujarat, Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh are listed as target areas -- http://old.jau.in/attachments/New%20Variety%20Release/DCashCrops.pdf

EVIDENCE DIGEST: Gujarat Cotton-46 (G.Cot-46: Sorath Swet Hem)

Name note: The CSC release name and the Seednet name are the same string in the input, and no separate Seednet page was retrieved. All evidence below refers to the name "Gujarat Cotton-46 (G.Cot-46: Sorath Swet Hem)" as it appears in the sources. One JAU page uses "G.Cot.Hy-46", which conflicts with the open-pollinated type recorded in the release list (see PUBLICATIONS and BREEDER AND INSTITUTION).

STRESS TOLERANCE
- No variety-specific evidence found for drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence tolerance of G.Cot-46. A salinity-trial report mentions salt-tolerant cotton cultivars in coastal Gujarat, but it does not name G.Cot-46 -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/311739945_Prospects_and_impact_of_cultivating_salt_tolerant_varieties_of_cotton_and_wheat_in_coastal_saline_soils_of_Gujarat

DISEASE AND PEST
- No variety-specific resistance data found for G.Cot-46. Zone-level data from the AICRP 2024-25 report give grey mildew, bacterial leaf blight and Alternaria incidence for Gujarat in the Central Zone, but these are not tied to this variety -- https://cicr.org.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/AICRP-2024-25-final-1.pdf
- A general Gujarat variety review says the top-ranked variety shows moderate tolerance to diseases and pests, but the page does not name G.Cot-46 -- https://krishijagran.com/agripedia/top-varieties-of-cotton-in-gujarat/

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- A JAU release file has a cotton entry for a variety whose name is not legible in the extract, listing potential yield of 2538 kg/ha seed cotton and 820 kg/ha lint, and average yield of 2215 kg/ha seed cotton and 769 kg/ha lint. It also lists sowing from 15 June to 10 July at 120 x 45 cm, and N:P:K 160:0:120 kg/ha. Whether this entry is G.Cot-46 is unverified -- http://old.jau.in/attachments/New%20Variety%20Release/DCashCrops.pdf
- The same JAU entry recommends the variety for irrigated kharif cotton in Gujarat, Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh (Central Zone) -- http://old.jau.in/attachments/New%20Variety%20Release/DCashCrops.pdf
- No multi-location or AICRP trial results for G.Cot-46 found -- https://cicr.org.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/AICRP-2024-25-final-1.pdf

GENETICS AND QTL
- No evidence found (no parentage, marker or QTL data; parentage is "Not specified" in the input and was not found elsewhere).

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- The Cotton Research Station at Junagadh was set up in 1962 and works on breeding tetraploid G. hirsutum cotton -- https://www.jau.in/cotton-research-station-junagadh
- The JAU station page lists "G.Cot.Hy-46" among varieties released, which conflicts with the OPV classification in the release list -- https://jau.in/index.php?Itemid=39&catid=2&id=100%3Acotton-research-station&option=com_content&view=article
- Dr. M. G. Valu is named as Research Scientist (Cotton) and Unit Head at the Junagadh station (Genetics and Plant Breeding). He is not confirmed as the developer of G.Cot-46 -- https://www.jau.in/cotton-research-station-junagadh
- The station was strengthened to produce nucleus, breeder and foundation seed of cotton -- https://www.jau.in/cotton-research-station-junagadh
- Institution as given in the input: Cotton Research Station, Junagadh Agricultural University. The JAU Cotton station has a 2008 GM cotton project and an AICRP cotton centre -- https://www.aiccip.cicr.org.in/Junagadh.html
- No lead breeder for G.Cot-46 named in any source found.

CONTACT DETAILS
- Dr. M. G. Valu, Research Scientist (Cotton) and Unit Head, Cotton Research Station, JAU -- phone (0285) 2674150; PBX 2672080-90 Ext. -- https://www.jau.in/cotton-research-station-junagadh

PUBLICATIONS

No QTL or marker study specific to this variety was found. -- searched; none returned

Station page lists a Research Scientist (Cotton) and Unit Head, Dr. M. G. Valu (Ph.D., Genetics and Plant Breeding). The page does not state that he bred this variety, so this is station-level only. -- https://www.jau.in/cotton-research-station-junagadh
Station background: the station is the cotton unit of JAU, established under Gujarat Act No. 5 of 2004; the station page gives its establishment year as 1962. -- https://www.jau.in/index.php/component/content/article/2-init-content/research/100-cotton-research-station
No named lead breeder for GJ.Cot-102 or GJHV-516 was found. The C.T. Patel (H-4 hybrid) result was discarded as an unrelated variety.

Postal address: Cotton Research Station, Junagadh Agricultural University, Junagadh 362001 (Gujarat). -- https://www.jau.in/cotton-research-station-junagadh

Chapara, Rani; Madugula, Sudharani (year not given in the snippet). Heterosis for Seed Fibre Quality Traits in Cotton (Gossypium hirsutum L.). Journal/report not stated -- https://zenodo.org/records/11125775
Note: this paper uses GJHV 516, one of the codes in this record, as a parent in a cross, so it is attributed here on the basis of that code only. The journal and year are not visible in the snippet.

The results were private cotton-seed traders and mandi price pages, none naming GJ.Cot-102 or GJHV-516, which were discarded. -- https://www.tradeindia.com/junagadh/cotton-seeds-city-198325.html

RECOMMENDED STATES
Recommended for irrigated cotton in Gujarat state (kharif), and also for release in the Central Zone states of Gujarat, Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh under irrigated conditions. -- http://old.jau.in/attachments/New%20Variety%20Release/DCashCrops.pdf

salinity.details: H-1300 is tolerant to salt and saline irrigation. In studies on tolerance to saline irrigation under drip systems, it showed the least reduction in stomatal conductance with increased salinity and exhibited an increase in certain performance metrics up to 2.5 dS/m.

agronomic_details.yield: H-1300 typically yields 22 to 23 quintal/ha under normal conditions. It was part of studies evaluating seed cotton yield under various irrigation methods and salinity levels. agronomic_details.field_trials: H-1300 has been evaluated in various field trials, including the All India Coordinated Research Project on Management of Salt Affected Soils and Use of Saline Water in Agriculture, specifically for its tolerance to saline irrigation under drip systems in Agra and Bikaner. drought.details: The CCSHAU varieties document lists 'Tolerant to water stress has been observed, tolerant to salinity' in the section that follows the HD 432 heading. The snippet is truncated, so attribution to HD 432 is probable but not fully confirmed. The CSC record gives only 'FIELD TOLERANT'. No drought physiology, mechanism or quantitative data were found. Level is a cautious estimate.

heat.details: The 'Tolerant to terminal heat stress' line in the CCSHAU document appears in a wheat entry, not under HD 432. No heat tolerance evidence for HD 432 was found.

salinity.details: The CCSHAU document states 'Tolerant to salt' near the HD 432 entry, which is also described as released for cultivation in Haryana. In the AICRP Salt Affected Soils biennial report (2008-10), HD-123 and HD-432 were tested under saline irrigation. HD-432 was described as the second most sensitive genotype in one trial, but its mean seed cotton yield (77.3 g/m2) was higher than that of HD-123 (40.3 g/m2). HD-432 had the maximum sympod number (41) at 2.5 dS/m. Overall, tolerance appears moderate, with some conflicting statements.

flood.details: No flood tolerance data found for HD 432. The AICRP 2025 proceedings mention waterlogging studies in cotton, but no result for HD 432 is shown.

disease_resistance.summary: A breeder CV describes HD 432 as tolerant to Fusarium wilt. A slide deck lists HD 432 among disease-resistant varieties, a secondary and non-specific source. The 'Moderately resistant to Leaf Blight' line in the CCSHAU document belongs to a different crop entry. Cotton leaf curl disease is a concern for upland cotton, but no HD 432 reaction was confirmed.

pest_resistance.summary: No specific pest resistance was documented. HD 432 was used as the test variety in a CCSHAU MSc entomology study of seasonal bollworm incidence (sown 18.04.2020, spacing 67.5 x 30 cm), which indicates it is susceptible to bollworm attack and was not selected for resistance. The stem borer line in the CCSHAU document relates to another crop.

agronomic_details.yield: No quantitative yield in the CSC record. A breeder CV describes it as a high yielder. In the saline irrigation trial, mean seed cotton yield was 77.3 g/m2 (HD-432) versus 40.3 g/m2 (HD-123). Fibre: 2.5% span length 21.2 mm, micronaire 7.0, strength 17.0 g/tex (CSC record).
agronomic_details.stability: Multi-environment stability data not found. It is recommended in ICAR Kharif Agro-Advisories 2025 alongside HD-123 and HD-324 for desi cotton, indicating continued use. Desi cotton hybrid AAH-1 is flagged for yield reduction in the same advisory.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Released for cultivation in Haryana. Suited to normal planting in the north Indian desi cotton zone. Tolerant of saline conditions to a moderate degree. Plant height is 170-180 cm.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: 1. GREEN PLANT BODY WITH DEEP CUT LOBE LEAVES 2. WHITE PETAL WITH YELLOW POLLEN COLOUR WITH RED SPOT AT THE INNER BASE OF THE PETAL. 3. SEMI ERECT PLANT HABIT.
agronomic_details.field_trials: Tested in AICRP salinity trials (2008-10) including drip irrigation and saline water studies. A sowing-date study used HD 432 sown in the first fortnight of May 2017. Included in the AICRP Cotton AGM 2025 proceedings as a check at Sirsa (listed alongside CISA 310). Recommended seed rate is 8-10 kg/ha at 67.5 x 30 cm spacing.

genetics_and_breeding.genetic_markers: No QTL, SNP or SSR information for HD 432 was found. Parentage is HD 167 x DS 5 (CSC record).
genetics_and_breeding.qtl_information: None found.
genetics_and_breeding.molecular_mechanisms: None found. The strong stem that confers lodging resistance and low kapas shedding is a morphological trait with no molecular characterization in the sources.

commercial_info.seed_corporations: No specific seed corporation listing found. The variety is registered or listed in PPV&FR Authority annual reports (2020-21 and 2021-22) in the DUS cotton context.
commercial_info.private_dealers: None identified.

drought.details: No drought test of HHB 223 itself was found. HHB 223 is listed as dwarf, early maturing, with synchronous tillering in the AICPMIP release table. Indirect evidence only: HBL 11, the male parent of HHB 223, is the basis of marker-assisted terminal drought work at CCS HAU, and the authors suggest HHB 223 could be improved for terminal drought tolerance through improved HBL 11 lines. This does not establish the drought level of HHB 223.

heat.details: No heat tolerance evidence for HHB 223 was found in the digest.

salinity.details: No salinity evidence for HHB 223 was found. The ICAR 2010-11 annual report salt-tolerance passage describes a different entry (amber grain, 11% protein) and is not attributed to HHB 223.

flood.details: No flood tolerance test of HHB 223 was found.

disease_resistance.summary: Resistant to downy mildew and blast, as described by the AICPMIP/millets.res.in variety list. No independent disease screening data for HHB 223 was found.

pest_resistance.summary: No pest-resistance data for HHB 223 was found in the searched sources.

agronomic_details.yield: Average yield of 26 Q/ha is recorded in the input (CSC-preferred) record. No independent yield potential claim for HHB 223 was found in AICPMIP or ICAR sources. The CCS HAU six-hybrid trial yield values are garbled in the extracted table and are not cited.
agronomic_details.stability: Not found in searched sources (no multi-environment stability analysis for HHB 223 identified beyond the two-season Hisar comparison and six-hybrid trial summarised under field_trials).
agronomic_details.adaptation: Input record: for irrigated tracts in Haryana state. Source-listed recommended states are broader (see variety_profile). The input record specifies Eastern Rajasthan, whereas the AICPMIP/millets.res.in list gives Rajasthan without the east qualifier; this discrepancy is flagged for the release minutes to resolve.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Dwarf stature, early maturity and synchronous tillering (AICPMIP table). Compact, cylindrical earheads (AICPMIP table) and conical earheads with long purple bristles (millets.res.in); the two earhead descriptions differ. Dual-purpose use (millets.res.in). Earhead girth 2.6 cm and test weight 11.16 g in the Hisar trial (highest among compared entries). Higher tillering under irrigation in the CCS HAU six-hybrid trial.
agronomic_details.field_trials: (1) Hisar irrigated and rainfed trial (Journal of Applied and Natural Science, DOI 10.31018/JANS.V6I2.431): HHB 223 recorded the highest earhead girth (2.6 cm) and test weight (11.16 g) among HHB 67 Improved, HHB 197, HHB 223 and HHB 234. (2) Six-hybrid trial at CCS HAU, Hisar, kharif 2016 and 2017: HHB 223 showed higher tillering under irrigation; yield values are garbled in the extracted table, so no yield figure is reported. (3) AICPMIP seed-requirement table (2016-17 trial proceedings): HHB 223 listed at 2 kg per trial entry; this is a seed requirement, not a performance result.

genetics_and_breeding.genetic_markers: No SSR, SNP or marker data specific to HHB 223 was found. Foreground markers linked to LG2 and LG5 are reported for improved HBL 11 MAS work for terminal drought; these concern the male parent HBL 11, not HHB 223 directly. Parentage conflict: AICPMIP/millets.res.in gives ICMA 94555 x HBL 11, whereas the input record gives female H-1157 and male H-1220. The conflict is flagged for verification and the input record is not overwritten.
genetics_and_breeding.qtl_information: No QTL or marker study specific to HHB 223 was found. QTL/MAS work reported for HBL 11 (male parent) targets terminal drought.

commercial_info.seed_corporations: Rajasthan State Seeds Corporation kharif-2023 list shows RHB-223 bajra (4500.20 quintals), not HHB-223; not confirmed as this variety. No NSC or Haryana Seeds Development Corporation listing for HHB 223 was found.
commercial_info.private_dealers: IndiaMART listings show generic hybrid bajra sellers, not HHB 223 specifically. The seednet name HHH-223 (crop listed as cotton/kapas) was not searched and no evidence was found; the cotton label appears to be a portal error.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
STRESS TOLERANCE
- HHB 223 (MH 1468) is listed as having dwarf stature, early maturity and synchronous tillering in the AICPMIP release table, but no drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence test of HHB 223 itself was found. The AICPMIP table also gives it compact, cylindrical earheads and a 2010 notification. -- https://www.aicpmip.res.in/varietiesreleased.pdf
- Indirect only: HBL 11, the male parent of HHB 223, is the basis of marker-assisted terminal drought work at CCS HAU, and the authors suggest HHB 223 could be improved for terminal drought tolerance through improved HBL 11 lines. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/336428571_Introgression_of_terminal_drought_stress_tolerance_in_advance_lines_of_popular_pearl_millet_hybrid_through_molecular_breeding ; https://www.researchgate.net/publication/353750645_Development_of_advance_pearl_millet_lines_tolerant_to_terminal_drought_stress_using_marker-assisted_selection
- Salinity: the ICAR 2010-11 annual report salt-tolerance passage describes a different entry (amber grain, 11% protein), not HHB 223, so it is not attributed here. -- https://icar.org.in/sites/default/files/2022-05/crop-improvement-AR-2010-11_0.pdf

DISEASE AND PEST
- The AICPMIP/millets.res.in list describes HHB 223 as resistant to downy mildew and blast. -- https://www.millets.res.in/technologies/pearl_millet.pdf ; https://www.aicpmip.res.in/varietiesreleased.pdf
- No pest-resistance data for HHB 223 was found.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Medium maturity, conical earheads with long purple bristles, dual-purpose use. -- https://www.millets.res.in/technologies/pearl_millet.pdf
- Hisar irrigated/rainfed trial (Journal of Applied and Natural Science, DOI 10.31018/JANS.V6I2.431): HHB 223 recorded the highest earhead girth (2.6 cm) and test weight (11.16 g) among HHB 67 Improved, HHB 197, HHB 223 and HHB 234. -- https://www.academia.edu/77167338/Performance_of_pearl_millet_genotypes_under_irrigated_and_rainfed_conditions_at_Hisar_India
- Six-hybrid trial at CCS HAU, Hisar (kharif 2016 and 2017): HHB 223 showed higher tillering under irrigation; yield values in the extracted table are garbled, so no yield figure is cited. -- https://www.ijpab.com/form/2018%20Volume%206,%20issue%203/IJPAB-2018-6-3-346-351.pdf
- AICPMIP seed-requirement table lists HHB 223 at 2 kg per trial entry (2016-17 trial proceedings). -- http://www.aicpmip.res.in/pw2017.pdf
- Yield potential claims from AICPMIP/ICAR sources for HHB 223 specifically were not found.

GENETICS AND QTL
- Parentage per AICPMIP/millets.res.in: ICMA 94555 x HBL 11. This conflicts with the input record (female H-1157, male H-1220). Flagged for verification, not overwritten. -- https://www.millets.res.in/technologies/pearl_millet.pdf
- HBL 11 is the male parent of HHB 223, and the improved HBL 11 MAS work is linked to LG2 and LG5 foreground markers for terminal drought. -- https://www.ias.ac.in/article/fulltext/jgen/100/0088 ; https://www.researchgate.net/publication/353750645_Development_of_advance_pearl_millet_lines_tolerant_to_terminal_drought_stress_using_marker-assisted_selection
- No QTL or marker study specific to HHB 223 was found.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Name variety_name "HHB 223 (MH 1468)": evidence refers to this name. Notification S.O.211(E), dated 29.01.2010 (one source gives 29.1.2010), breeder institution CCS Haryana Agricultural University (CCS HAU), Hisar, through AICPMIP. -- https://www.aicpmip.res.in/varietiesreleased.pdf ; https://www.millets.res.in/technologies/pearl_millet.pdf

EVIDENCE DIGEST: HS 292 (cotton, Gossypium; CSC name and Seednet name both "HS 292", so one set of evidence covers both)
Searches run: 4 of 4 allowed. Only one institutional source (the CCS HAU Cotton Research Station, Sirsa) was found, so most headings are thin.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Resistant to lodging and drought; early maturity lets it escape bollworm -- https://hau.ac.in/public/pages-pdf/1567662228.pdf
- Highly resistant to leafhopper and bacterial blight; "basic tolerance" to pests and diseases is claimed -- https://hau.ac.in/public/pages-pdf/1567662228.pdf
- Heat, salinity, flood and submergence tolerance: No evidence found

DISEASE AND PEST
- Leafhopper resistance and bacterial blight resistance (as above) -- https://hau.ac.in/public/pages-pdf/1567662228.pdf
- Bollworm: escape via early maturity, not resistance -- https://hau.ac.in/public/pages-pdf/1567662228.pdf

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Tall growing, 150-190 cm, taller in humid and fertile soils -- https://hau.ac.in/public/pages-pdf/1567662228.pdf
- Average yield 22.4 q/ha; few pickings needed, which lowers picking cost -- https://hau.ac.in/public/pages-pdf/1567662228.pdf
- Combines high yield potential, high boll weight and better ginning outturn; fibre is coarse and short, unsuitable for mill spinning, suited to domestic, medical dressing and non-spinning uses -- https://hau.ac.in/public/pages-pdf/1567662228.pdf
- Multi-location or coordinated trial data specific to HS 292: No evidence found (a sister line, HS 298, ranked first for seed cotton yield in the South Zone coordinated trials; HS 296, HS 300 and HS 304 were also tested in coordinated trials) -- https://hau.ac.in/public/pages-pdf/1567662228.pdf

GENETICS AND QTL
- Parentage listed as "Not specified" in the input; no pedigree found in the search results -- No evidence found

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Developing institution: Chaudhary Charan Singh Haryana Agricultural University (CCS HAU), Hisar, through its Cotton Research Station, Sirsa -- https://hau.ac.in/page/home-20

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: H 1316 (Cotton)

Search scope: 4 web_search queries were run (variety/crop, breeder/institution, research papers, seed availability). Names searched: "H 1316" (variety_name and variety_code, which are identical here). The seednet_variety_name is recorded as "Unknown", so no separate Seednet-name search was run. No result on any query named H 1316 together with cotton.

STRESS TOLERANCE -- No evidence found. The variety-plus-crop search returned unrelated pages (a US patent for "19R316B3TXF" cotton, and a BIS standard for cotton fabric damage, IS 1316). Neither names H 1316 as a cotton variety. -- https://image-ppubs.uspto.gov/dirsearch-public/print/downloadPdf/12108730 ; https://archive.org/details/gov.in.is.1316.1984

DISEASE AND PEST -- No evidence found. Same results as above; nothing on resistance for H 1316.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS -- No evidence found. No multi-location or field-trial result names H 1316.

GENETICS AND QTL (genes, parentage, breeding-line codes, breeding method, genome resources) -- No evidence found. Parentage is listed as "Unknown" and no search result gave it.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION -- No evidence found for H 1316. The CCS HAU Department of Genetics & Plant Breeding directory PDF was returned, but it lists faculty only and does not mention this variety, so it is not attributed to H 1316. -- https://hau.ac.in/public/pages-pdf/1689650060.pdf

CONTACT DETAILS -- No evidence found for a breeder contact. The only institutional page returned is the department directory above, which does not name H 1316. No institute contact is attributed to this variety on the basis of that page. Institution given in the record: CCS HAU, Hisar (not independently verified by search).

PUBLICATIONS -- No evidence found. The "research paper" search returned only an unrelated BIS standard (IS 1316) and no journal, AICRP, or KrishiKosh item for H 1316.

SEED AVAILABILITY -- No evidence found. The seed-availability search returned a general Wikipedia article on seed security. No NSC, state seed corporation, KVK, SAU or dealer listing for H 1316 was found.

RECOMMENDED STATES -- Record value only, not verified by search: Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat (from the input record). No search result confirmed this.

YEAR OF RELEASE -- Unknown (not found in search).

Recommended next steps: the search index does not appear to cover this variety. Check the CSC/AICRP cotton release notification minutes and the seednet.gov.in portal directly, and query KrishiKosh and the AICRP on Cotton annual reports with the exact name "H 1316" or "H-1316".

drought.details: No evidence found on drought tolerance specific to this variety. The digest reports a rainfed Vertisol plant-density trial in Central India, where the optimum density was about 0.74 lakh plants/ha, versus 0.37 lakh plants/ha for PKV 081 Bt and Rajat Bt. This is an agronomic density result and does not establish drought tolerance or its mechanisms.

disease_resistance.summary: In a screening of parental Bt lines and HxB hybrids, the entry GJHV 374 Bt was reported free of the studied diseases ALS, TSV and boll rot, but the digest states it was infected by rust (the only exception noted). The digest's wording is 'free of the studied diseases (ALS, TSV, boll rot) except rust'. Hybrids derived from GJHV 374 Bt (e.g. GJHV 374 Bt x ICB 194, reported free of TSV but infected by Alternaria) are different entries and are NOT attributed to this variety. No other disease evidence found for this variety.

pest_resistance.summary: Jassid tolerance: Not found in searched sources for this variety. A CICR breeder page mentions jassid-tolerance work using GJHV374 Bt as a male parent in hybrid crosses; this is not a tolerance finding for the variety itself and is not counted as resistance. No other pest evidence found.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: ICAR-CICR GJHV 374 Bt (Cotton, Gossypium hirsutum)

Name check: variety_name and seednet_variety_name are identical ("ICAR-CICR GJHV 374 Bt"). The Seednet portal was not returned by any search, so no Seednet page was checked. Other names seen: "CICR-H Cotton 41" (ICAR-CICR At-Glance PDF).

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Evaluated under rainfed conditions on a Vertisol in Central India; the optimum planting density for this variety was about 0.74 lakh plants/ha, versus 0.37 lakh for PKV 081 Bt and Rajat Bt -- https://pub.isa-india.in/index.php/ija/article/view/5835
- The same rainfed density trial appears in a ResearchGate listing, which gives the density result for GJHV 374 Bt -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/348365111_ECONOMIC_ANALYSIS_OF_BT_COTTON_CULTIVATION_IN_WARANGAL_DISTRICT_OF_TELANGANA_STATE
- No evidence found on drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence tolerance specific to this variety.

DISEASE AND PEST
- In a screening of parental Bt lines and HxB hybrids, the entry GJHV 374 Bt was reported free of the studied diseases (ALS, TSV, boll rot) except rust -- https://arccjournals.com/journal/indian-journal-of-agricultural-research/A-6541
- Hybrids derived from GJHV 374 Bt (for example GJHV 374 Bt x ICB 194, found free of TSV but infected by Alternaria) are different entries and are not attributed to the variety here -- http://www.plantarchives.org/article/1867-1876%20(379).pdf
- Jassid tolerance: no evidence found specific to this variety. A CICR breeder page mentions jassid-tolerance work using GJHV374 Bt as a male parent in hybrid crosses, which is not a tolerance finding for the variety itself -- https://cicr.org.in/crop-improvement/

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Maturity 150 days and average yield 2525 kg/ha, listed for Maharashtra adaptability in an ICAR table -- https://icar.org.in/en/crop-science/fodder-production
- Rainfed Vertisol multi-density trial (Idapuganti et al., 2025, Vol. 70 No. 1) -- https://doi.org/10.59797/ija.v70i1.5835
- Trial of four Bt varieties (PKV081 Bt, Suraj Bt, Rajat Bt, GJHV 374 Bt) across plant densities, with seed cotton yield and earliness index measured -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/242196172_Comparative_Growth_and_Yield_of_Cotton_Planted_at_Various_Densities_and_Configurations
- Economic analysis of Bt cotton in Warangal district, Telangana, with GJHV 374 Bt in plant-density trials (note: a Telangana study, not a recommendation) -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/348365111_ECONOMIC_ANALYSIS_OF_BT_COTTON_CULTIVATION_IN_WARANGAL_DISTRICT_OF_TELANGANA_STATE

GENETICS AND QTL (genes, parentage, breeding-line codes, breeding method, genome resources)
- Breeding method stated as development using modern biotechnological tools; no further detail found -- https://icar.org.in/en/crop-science/fodder-production
- Parentage "GJHV 374 variety x BN Bt (Mon 531)" was supplied in the task input only; no search source confirmed it. -- user-supplied input, not verified
- The CICR staff profile lists development of this variety as a project contribution; no gene, event or QTL detail given -- https://cicr.org.in/m-saravanan/
- No evidence found on Bt event, QTL, marker, or genome resources specific to this variety.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Lead developer: Dr. Suman Bala Singh; species G. hirsutum; year 2020; centre NGP; adoption MH -- https://cicr.org.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/ICAR-CICR-At-Glance-with-coverpages.pdf
- Release-listed authors (from the 2023 release citation) include S.B. Singh, K.R. Kranthi, S. Kranthi, V. Santhy, K.P. Raghavendra, B. Fande, S. Bhave, U. Satija, A.H. Prakash, S. Manickam, B. Desouza, M. Saravanan, H.B. Santosh and M.D. Khanpara -- https://aiccip.cicr.org.in/v-santhy/
- M.D. Khanpara (2023) is listed as a release author for "Bt Cotton variety ICAR-CICR GJHV374 Bt" -- https://cicr.org.in/m-saravanan/
- Institution: ICAR-Central Institute for Cotton Research, Nagpur -- https://cicr.org.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/ICAR-CICR-At-Glance-with-coverpages.pdf
- Released for rainfed conditions of Maharashtra (CRIDA staff page) -- https://www.icar-crida.res.in/staff_dcs_sc_santosh.html

CONTACT DETAILS

EVIDENCE DIGEST: Jawahar Oat (variety_name) / JAWAHAR TAPTI (seednet_variety_name), forage oat, JO 07-310
Searches run: 4. Only one result names this variety. Evidence for the Seednet name JAWAHAR TAPTI was not found, so the findings below refer to "Jawahar Oat- JO 07-310" as printed in the ICAR report.

STRESS TOLERANCE -- No evidence found. The searches returned no page naming this variety with drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence tolerance. Results were about other oat varieties or other crops.

DISEASE AND PEST -- Jawahar Oat- JO 07-310 is listed as moderately resistant to leaf spot and blight in the ICAR annual report for 2024-25 -- https://icar.org.in/sites/default/files/2025-10/ICAR%20Eng%20Annual%20Report_2024-25.pdf
No pest-resistance evidence was found.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS -- The ICAR 2024-25 report lists the variety with an average green fodder yield of 575-600 q/ha and a maturity of 130-140 days -- https://icar.org.in/sites/default/files/2025-10/ICAR%20Eng%20Annual%20Report_2024-25.pdf
No multi-location trial or AICRP trial data specific to this variety was found. The JNKVV Jabalpur nitrogen-level studies in the search results name other oat entries (for example JHO-822 and OS-6), not Jawahar Oat, so they were discarded -- https://archive.dbskkv.org/collection/292/document/1319

GENETICS AND QTL -- No evidence found. Parentage (Maljari x NA 39, NA 48, NA 32, G-27) was not confirmed by any retrieved page.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION -- The ICAR 2024-25 report credits the variety to Jawaharlal Nehru Krishi Vishwa Vidyalaya, Jabalpur, under the ICAR-AICRP on Forage Crops listing -- https://icar.org.in/sites/default/files/2025-10/ICAR%20Eng%20Annual%20Report_2024-25.pdf
No breeder or scientist name for this variety was found.

CONTACT DETAILS -- No breeder contact was found. Institute-level only: Jawaharlal Nehru Krishi Vishwa Vidyalaya, Jabalpur (named in the ICAR report). No email, phone, postal address or contact-page URL was found in the search results for the institute or the AICRP forage unit.

PUBLICATIONS -- No evidence found. No paper, thesis, report or conference item was found that names Jawahar Oat or JO 07-310. A 2024 PMC review on fodder oat seed production in India lists JNKVV among contributing institutions but does not name this variety in the retrieved text -- https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12009856/

SEED AVAILABILITY -- No evidence found. No Seednet entry for JAWAHAR TAPTI, NSC, state seed corporation, KVK, SAU or dealer listing for this variety was returned. The Seednet crop name in the record is "COTTON (KAPAS)", which does not match the forage oat crop, so the Seednet record itself should be checked. Results were unrelated overseas or hobby seed vendors and an Indian oat-seller listing with no variety name -- https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/oats-seed-9161190212.html

RECOMMENDED STATES -- Suitable for all parts of fodder growing area in Madhya Pradesh per the ICAR 2024-25 report -- https://icar.org.in/sites/default/files/2025-10/ICAR%20Eng%20Annual%20Report_2024-25.pdf
This conflicts with the record's recommended states (Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh). Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh were not confirmed by any retrieved source.

RELEASE -- The ICAR 2024-25 report lists the variety among released forage and other crop varieties, but the retrieved text gives no notification or release date. The 2024-08-02 date in the record is unverified -- https://icar.org.in/sites/default/files/2025-10/ICAR%20Eng%20Annual%20Report_2024-25.pdf

RVK-11 (Raj Vijay Kapas-11, IH 11) -- DIGEST

Name note: the evidence below refers to RVK-11 (variety_name). No page was found under the Seednet name K-11 for this variety. Every "K 11" hit describes a different Tamil Nadu Karunganni cotton (TKA-188, G. arboreum), so those hits were excluded.

STRESS TOLERANCE
No evidence found. The searches returned no drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence data for RVK-11.

DISEASE AND PEST
No evidence found for RVK-11 resistance traits. The Khandwa centre profile lists RVK-11 among its non-Bt varieties, but it gives no resistance claim: Desi cotton (G. arboreum) varieties Khandwa-2, JK-4, Jawahar Tapti, American cotton variety Sarbottam, JK-4, Jk-35, RVK-11 and RVK-67 are the famous non Bt varieties released by this Centre. -- https://aiccip.cicr.org.in/CZ-MP-Khandwa.html
Conflict on species: the same profile also describes RVK-11 as G hirsutum Non Bt variety released for Madhya Pradesh by MP state Variety Release Committee, Bhopal in 2016 -- https://aiccip.cicr.org.in/CZ-MP-Khandwa.html

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- RVK-11 was released as a G hirsutum non-Bt variety for Madhya Pradesh by the MP state variety release committee in 2016. -- https://aiccip.cicr.org.in/CZ-MP-Khandwa.html
- The Khandwa centre reports nucleus seed production of RVK 11 under its 2020-21 research achievements. -- https://aiccip.cicr.org.in/CZ-MP-Khandwa.html
- The RVSKVV newsletter says Cotton variety RVK 11 has been Notified vide No. SO 3220 (E) 06.09.2019 for south Zone (Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and -- the text is cut off before the state list. -- http://www.rvskvv.net/images/Newsletter_Jul-Dec-2019_16.06.2020.pdf
- Yield, maturity and trial data for RVK-11: No evidence found. The yield (2000-2100 kg/ha) and 113-day maturity in the same newsletter passage belong to a legume variety described before the RVK 11 notice, so they were excluded. -- http://www.rvskvv.net/images/Newsletter_Jul-Dec-2019_16.06.2020.pdf

GENETICS AND QTL
No evidence found for RVK-11 QTL, marker or genetic studies. The parentage supplied in the record (07940-1-D x 11876 x 07794-1-D x H450) matches a different variety, TNAU's K 11 (TKA-188), so it cannot be attributed to RVK-11. -- https://masujournal.org/view_archive_journal.php?id=2466

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Lead breeder name for RVK-11: No evidence found.
- Developing institution: the RVSKVV cotton centre at Khandwa is named as the centre that released RVK-11 (RVK-11 and RVK-67 are the famous non Bt varieties released by this Centre.) -- https://aiccip.cicr.org.in/CZ-MP-Khandwa.html
- Dr. Dinesh Kumar Paliwal appears as a Scientist on the Khandwa centre page, but the page does not link him to RVK-11, so he is not attributed as breeder. -- https://aiccip.cicr.org.in/CZ-MP-Khandwa.html

drought.details: Drought tolerance is claimed in several sources, but most are secondary or vendor claims. A vendor listing describes stable yields under severe drought (about 6-8 quintal/acre). A testbook summary (not a primary source) describes it as drought tolerant and suited to dry, semi-arid regions. An Anantapuramu on-farm study describes it as resistant to drought, with rainfed potential of 20-25 q/ha and irrigated potential of 45-50 q/ha. Minikit demonstrations (2015-2018) recorded drought resistance. The digest contains no physiological mechanism data. Input record: recommended for low rainfall (<250 mm) and marginal fertility soils of winter rainfed vertisol tracts in southern Tamil Nadu. The 'medium' level reflects consistent but largely non-primary claims.

Digest trials in Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka. The digest does not confirm Telangana or Tamil Nadu adaptation from trial data.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Vendor listing: maturity 112 days, 51% oil, 70% shelling, kharif season, seed rate 75 kg/acre, spacing 12-20 inches. Protein about 28% and oil 51%, compared with 48% oil in Kadiri-6 (Anantapuramu study). Minikit demonstrations noted dark foliage. The notification-derived description of a high-yielding Spanish bunch type is recorded in the abstract. Maturity conflicts exist between the input (135-140 days) and the vendor listing (112 days).
agronomic_details.field_trials: (1) Chittoor district on-farm test, rabi 2020-21 and kharif 2021-22: pod yield 28.0% and 13.5% above farmer practice. (2) Kurnool on-farm test, kharif 2020 and 2021: seed yield 3375 kg/ha, 28.5% above Nitya Haritha and 35.1% above K-6. (3) Karnataka north transitional zone trial: dry pod yield 2745 kg/ha, statistically on par with Dh-256; stem rot 3.8% versus 8.1% for JL-24. (4) Anantapuramu on-farm study: rainfed potential 20-25 q/ha, irrigated 45-50 q/ha. (5) Minikit demonstrations, 15 farmer fields, 2015-2018: 1187 kg/ha versus 980 kg/ha for Kadiri-6. (6) Published abstract trial/notification yield: 3840 kg/ha dry pod, 2666 kg/ha kernel, about 31.9% above TAG 24.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: K 1812 / Kadiri Lepakshi (groundnut)

Name note: the evidence refers to "Kadiri Lepakshi (K 1812)", the CSC/release name "K 1812". No search result mentioned "K-12" in connection with this groundnut variety. The Seednet listing under "COTTON (KAPAS)" was not reached, so the Seednet record is unverified and its crop label conflicts with the groundnut evidence.

Search coverage: four web_search queries were run: (1) release and notification, (2) breeder and station (the query was phrased "breeder Agricultural Research Station Kadiri"), (3) research papers and trials, (4) seed availability, which also tried "K-12". No seednet.gov.in page was returned.

Conflicts with the input record:
- Parentage: the input says K 11 x K 9. The ICAR-JOR notification abstract says it is a derivative of the complex cross ((ICGV 92069 x ICGV 93184)SIL4 x ICGV 98300). The input parentage is not supported by any result.
- Recommended states: the input lists Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu and Karnataka. The JOR notification says it was notified for All India Summer Zone IIIa, covering Karnataka and Maharashtra. No result confirmed Telangana or Tamil Nadu.
- Release date: the input gives 9 Nov 2020. Secondary sources give only "2020" with no day.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Described as drought tolerant, with stable yields under severe drought (about 6-8 quintal/acre per the vendor listing) -- https://fuleseeds.com/products/kadiri-lepakshi-k-1812/
- Described as drought tolerant and suited to dry, semi-arid regions (testbook summary, not a primary source) -- https://testbook.com/question-answer/new-variety-of-crop-kadiri-lepakshi-181239--67ac8476ae8a4ebecf726ae7
- Described as resistant to pests, diseases and drought in a Anantapuramu on-farm study; rainfed potential 20-25 q/ha and irrigated 45-50 q/ha -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/375506325_Performance_of_Kadiri_Lepakshi_K-1812_groundnut_in_Anantapuram_district_of_Andhra_Pradesh_India
- Minikit demonstrations (2015-2018) recorded drought resistance and resistance to sucking pests, with dark foliage noted -- https://aatcc.peerjournals.net/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Impact-of-Minikit-Demonstrations-on-Productivity-and-Profitability-of-Groundnut-in-Anantapuramu-district-of-Andhra-Pradesh.pdf
- Heat and salinity, flood and submergence tolerance: No evidence found.

DISEASE AND PEST
- Notification abstract: described as multiple-resistant, with a high-yield Spanish bunch type -- https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/JOR/article/view/145280
- Specific diseases and pests named in the notification: not visible in the retrieved abstract; "Multiple resistant" is stated only in summary form.
- Stem rot incidence in a Karnataka trial was 3.8% for K-1812, lower than JL-24 (8.1%) -- https://journalijpss.com/index.php/IJPSS/article/view/4682
- Thrips and jassid resistance is claimed in a testbook summary, not a primary source -- https://testbook.com/question-answer/new-variety-of-crop-kadiri-lepakshi-181239--67ac8476ae8a4ebecf726ae7
- Listed among ICAR-DGR AICRP groundnut varieties described as tolerant to drought and resistant to multiple diseases and pests (2020 AICRP report, cited in a 2025 paper) -- https://www.agronomyjournals.com/archives/2025/vol8issue10/PartF/8-10-40-464.pdf

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Notification: average dry pod yield 3840 kg/ha and kernel yield 2666 kg/ha, about 31.9% above national check TAG 24 -- https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/JOR/article/view/145280
- Maturity 112 days; 51% oil; 70% shelling; kharif season; seed rate 75 kg/acre; spacing 12-20 inches -- https://fuleseeds.com/products/kadiri-lepakshi-k-1812/
- Protein about 28% and oil 51%, compared with 48% oil in Kadiri-6 -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/375506325_Performance_of_Kadiri_Lepakshi_K-1812_groundnut_in_Anantapuram_district_of_Andhra_Pradesh_India
- Chittoor district on-farm test (rabi 2020-21, kharif 2021-22): pod yield 28.0% and 13.5% above farmer practice -- https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/TJRA/article/view/138819
- Kurnool on-farm test (kharif 2020 and 2021): seed yield 3375 kg/ha, 28.5% above Nitya Haritha and 35.1% above K-6 -- https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/JOR/article/view/178148
- Karnataka north transitional zone trial: dry pod yield 2745 kg/ha, statistically on par with Dh-256 -- https://journalijpss.com/index.php/IJPSS/article/view/4682
- Minikit demonstrations (15 farmer fields, 2015-2018): 1187 kg/ha versus 980 kg/ha for Kadiri-6 -- https://aatcc.peerjournals.net/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Impact-of-Minikit-Demonstrations

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: KCH 305 BG II (cotton)

Name check: variety_name and seednet_variety_name are both "KCH 305 BG II", so one name was searched. No result named this variety under either name.

STRESS TOLERANCE
No evidence found. Searches returned nothing on drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence tolerance for KCH 305 BG II. Results covered other Kaveri BG II hybrids: KCH-144 (high-yield, high-ginning, 160-170 day claims) -- https://agribegri.com/products/buy-kaveri-seeds-kch-144-cotton-seeds.php ; KCH-36 (sturdy plant, 29-30 mm staple) -- https://kisancenter.com/product/kaveri-kch-36-cotton-seeds-bg2/217977 . These name different varieties and are not evidence for KCH 305 BG II.

DISEASE AND PEST
No evidence found. Nothing names KCH 305 BG II for pest or disease resistance. Results covered Bollgard II hybrids of other names: KCH-100 Money Maker -- https://agribegri.com/products/buy-kaveri-seeds-moneymaker-kch-100-bg-ii-cotton-seeds.php ; KCH-14K59 Jaadoo -- https://agribegri.com/products/buy-kaveri-seeds-jaddoo-bg-ii-cotton-seeds.php . Both are excluded as other varieties.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
No evidence found. No trial, yield, maturity or agronomy record names KCH 305 BG II. The AICRP BG II hybrid trial summary (2022-23 and 2023-24) names no Kaveri hybrid of this number -- https://caionline.in/uploads/publications/doc/ISSUE_NO__05_29-04-2025.pdf

GENETICS AND QTL
No evidence found. No parentage, marker or QTL record for KCH 305 BG II was returned. The parentage field "Not specified" stays unverified. The QTL paper returned (upland cotton boll number and boll weight) names no Kaveri hybrid -- https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC11353353/

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
No evidence found. No lead breeder or scientist is linked to KCH 305 BG II. Results that mention breeders (Wikipedia pages for Kaderbad Ravindranath and Rajagopalan Krishnamurthy) concern other people and varieties and were not attributed to this variety -- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaderbad_Ravindranath ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajagopalan_Krishnamurthy
Institution-level only: Kaveri Seed Company Ltd. describes itself as a hybrid-breeding company with cotton hybrids, but no page found names KCH 305 BG II -- https://www.kaveriseeds.in/our-story/details-of-business/

CONTACT DETAILS
No evidence found. No breeder contact, email, phone or address was found for KCH 305 BG II. The only institution-level page returned was the Kaveri company profile above, which gives no contact details. No institute contact page was found.

PUBLICATIONS
No evidence found. Searched for papers, reports and theses on KCH 305 BG II. The search returned no item that names this variety. Items returned but excluded because they name no KCH 305 BG II hybrid:
- Current Science 2024, blending of BG-II hybrids and refugia -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/382146455_Blending_procedure_is_crucial_for_BG-II_cotton_hybrids_to_adhere_to_the_prescribed_'Refugia_in_Bag'_standards (DOI 10.18520/cs/v127/i1/101-104 is the DOI of the paper)
- Springer 2025, integrated pest management in BG-II cotton -- https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s42690-025-01486-8

SEED AVAILABILITY
No evidence found. No NSC, state seed corporation, KVK, SAU or dealer listing for KCH 305 BG II was returned. The Seednet producers list names Kaveri's cotton varieties (KCH-126, KCH-135, Bheema/Kaveri-109 and others) but not KCH 305 BG II -- https://seednet.gov.in/material/Seed_Producers_Marketers.htm . Retailer pages for other Kaveri BG II hybrids (KCH-111 -- https://agribegri.com/products/buy-kaveri-seeds-kch-111-bg-ii-cotton-seeds.php) are not evidence for this variety.

RECOMMENDED STATES
No evidence found. No page confirms the recommended states from the input record (Gujarat, Maharashtra, Telangana, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu) for KCH 305 BG II. The GEAC commercial release list includes several Kaveri BG II hybrids (for example KCH-135 BG II and KCH-707 Bt BG II, both North and Central/South zones), but KCH 305 BG II does not appear in the excerpts returned -- http://www.geacindia.gov.in/resource-documents/approved-products/Final_commercially_approved.pdf

Summary: the four searches (variety and release, breeder, research, seed and Seednet/CSC) returned no page naming KCH 305 BG II. The release year (2020-11-09), institution and variety code A0501436 are therefore unverified by any source found. Checking the CSC release minutes and the Seednet variety page directly, or asking Kaveri Seed Company Ltd. for its data sheet, is the next step.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: LAHB Cotton - 1 (CSC name) / LAHB Cotton - 1 (Seednet name)

Name note: The CSC and Seednet names are identical in the input, and no separate Seednet portal page turned up. All evidence below refers to "LAHB Cotton-1" as written in the ANGRAU crop-variety PDF and the CAI bulletin.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- No evidence found for LAHB Cotton - 1. The "tolerant to jassids" and "resistant to BLB and grey mildew" statements in the ANGRAU PDF belong to the separate LHDP Cotton-1 entry, so I discarded them. -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf

DISEASE AND PEST
- No evidence found for LAHB Cotton - 1. The only pest and disease statements located were for LHDP Cotton-1, which I discarded. -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- The ANGRAU PDF gives a crop duration of 180-195 days (medium to late) for LAHB Cotton-1 in kharif, with a potential yield of 20-22 q/ha under irrigated conditions in the South Zone. -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf
- Fibre quality as listed by ANGRAU: ginning out turn 30.1%, extra-long staple length 37.1 mm, fineness 3.2 micronaire, tenacity 35.9 g/tex. -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf
- The CAI bulletin lists LAHB Cotton-1 (ANGRAU, 2021) in a hirsutum x barbadense hybrid table with the same fibre values (37.1, 3.2, 35.9) and an 80s count, and gives its zone as "South Zone States". -- https://caionline.in/uploads/publications/doc/ISSUE_NO__48_25-02-2025.pdf
- No multi-location trial results found for LAHB Cotton - 1. -- (no URL; searched)

GENETICS AND QTL
- The ANGRAU PDF describes LAHB Cotton-1 as an inter-specific hybrid of G. hirsutum x G. barbadense, bred by heterosis breeding. Parentage is not given, so the input "Not specified" stands. -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf
- No QTL or marker studies found for LAHB Cotton - 1. -- (no URL; searched)

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- The CAI bulletin attributes LAHB Cotton-1 to ANGRAU. -- https://caionline.in/uploads/publications/doc/ISSUE_NO__48_25-02-2025.pdf
- The ANGRAU PDF lists it under CVRC release. It does not name a breeder or a station. -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf
- Release year conflicts across sources: the ANGRAU PDF says 2019, the CAI bulletin says 2021, and the input says 2020-11-09. -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf ; https://caionline.in/uploads/publications/doc/ISSUE_NO__48_25-02-2025.pdf
- No lead breeder name is attributed to LAHB Cotton - 1 in any result. The ANGRAU cotton breeder profile (Kaderbad Ravindranath, Wikipedia) and the ANGRAU scientist Satish Yadlapalli appeared in results, but neither page names LAHB Cotton - 1, so I did not attribute them. -- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaderbad_Ravindranath ; https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=EV9PbaAAAAAJ&hl=en
- The ANGRAU Regional Agricultural Research Station named in the input is not mentioned in the LAHB evidence. -- (no URL; searched)

CONTACT DETAILS
- No evidence found: no breeder email, phone or postal address for LAHB Cotton - 1 was located.
- No institute-level contact page for ANGRAU's cotton division or the Regional Agricultural Research Station was located. The only ANGRAU URL found is the variety-list PDF: https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf

PUBLICATIONS
- No evidence found for LAHB Cotton - 1. The results that mention ANGRAU cotton papers (Yadlapalli, 2009) concern genetic diversity and stability in other cotton material, so I did not list them. -- https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=EV9PbaAAAAAJ&hl=en

SEED AVAILABILITY
- No evidence found for LAHB Cotton - 1. The single seed search returned only unrelated seed sellers (garden, heirloom and game-item results).
- The CAI bulletin contains a general sentence about National Seed Corporation and State Seed Corporation supplying breeder and foundation seed. It does not tie that sentence to LAHB Cotton-1, so I did not treat it as availability evidence. -- https://caionline.in/uploads/publications/doc/ISSUE_NO__48_25-02-2025.pdf

RECOMMENDED STATES
- The ANGRAU PDF gives the recommended area as the South Zone of India under irrigated conditions. -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf
- The CAI bulletin gives "South Zone States" for LAHB Cotton-1. -- https://caionline.in/uploads/publications/doc/ISSUE_NO__48_25-02-2025.pdf
- Neither source lists Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu by name. The input list is therefore not independently confirmed; it matches the South Zone wording only in general terms.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: LAXMI (variety_name) / LAXMI (seednet_variety_name), code 3636 (LTH-22)

Searches run: 4 (release/traits; breeder/institution; research papers; institution contact). Naming: the only evidence for this variety is the PPV&FRA registration for "Laxmi 3636 (LTH-22)", listed under maize, not cotton. Nothing I found links LAXMI to the Seednet "COTTON (KAPAS)" entry.

STRESS TOLERANCE
No evidence found. Searches on drought, heat, salinity, flood and submergence returned only general maize or unrelated hybrid studies, none naming Laxmi 3636 or LTH-22.

DISEASE AND PEST
No evidence found. No page named this variety with disease or pest reaction data.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
No evidence found. No yield, maturity or multi-location trial record names Laxmi 3636 or LTH-22.

GENETICS AND QTL
No evidence found. The parentage given in the record ("Gadag-1 x Co. 2") was not confirmed by any source. The one parentage line I saw, for a different maize hybrid, did not match this variety.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- The PPV&FRA registration lists the applicant as Yaaganti Seeds Pvt. Ltd., a private applicant, and gives the variety as "Extant (Notified)" under registration number 462 of 2018 -- https://plantauthority.gov.in/sites/default/files/compediumforallcategoryuptonov-2021.pdf
- No breeder or scientist name is linked to this variety in any source. The company's founder and manager names appear only as company background, so I have not attributed them to the variety -- https://www.indiamart.com/company/1127004/aboutus.html
- Release year 2015 from the CSC minutes was not verified. The PPV&FRA entry carries a 2018 registration number, not a release date.

CONTACT DETAILS (institute-level only; no breeder contact found)
- Company: Yaaganti Seeds Pvt. Ltd. Website http://www.yaagantiseeds.com, email yaaganti[at]gmail[dot]com, address No. 8-2-277/45, UBI Colony Road No. 3, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad-500034, Telangana; phone +91-11-26562122/25/33/44, 26567373, 26962819 -- https://www.indiascienceandtechnology.gov.in/allstinstitutions/yaaganti-seeds-pvt-ltd-0?language=en
- Address on Indiamart: 3rd Floor, No. 8-2-277/45, U.B.I Colony, Road No. 3, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad-500034; manager listed as Venkateswarlu Yaganti -- https://www.indiamart.com/company/1127004/
- Phone 040-23540745 (directory listing for Yaaganti Seeds Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad) -- https://www.vcsdata.com/company/Yaaganti-Seeds-Pvt-Ltd/424.html
- Registered applicant address in PPV&FRA: Survey No. 69, Gundlapochampally (Vill. & Panchayat), Medchal-Mandal, Rangareddy-501401, Telangana, with a second address at 18 Barakhamba Road, New Delhi-110001 -- https://plantauthority.gov.in/sites/default/files/compediumforallcategoryuptonov-2021.pdf
- Discarded: the email bhavani.b@nuziveeduseeds.com (a different company's domain), Yaaganti Agrotech Pvt. Ltd. (a separate firm), and Laxmi Seeds / Asha Agrisciences (Secunderabad).

PUBLICATIONS
No evidence found. Searches of journals, KrishiKosh and AICRP reports returned no paper, thesis or report on Laxmi 3636 or LTH-22.

SEED AVAILABILITY
- No evidence found for seed sales of Laxmi 3636 specifically. The Yaaganti retailer listing names hybrid maize "Laxmi Sagar", a different product -- https://www.indiamart.com/company/1127004/
- Seednet's producer/marketer page lists "Laxmi" only under soybean, sunflower and chilli entries, not cotton or maize for this variety -- https://seednet.gov.in/material/Seed_Producers_Marketers.htm

RECOMMENDED STATES
- Not verified. The states in the input record (Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu) did not appear in any source I found. The PPV&FRA entry gives no state-wise recommendation.

DISEASE AND PEST: No evidence found for LHDP Cotton-5. Excluded: the ANGRAU list gives LHDP Cotton-1 as tolerant to jassids and resistant to BLB and grey mildew, which is a different variety -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf. Also excluded: a rainfed jassid-screening paper (Lam, Guntur) lists "LHDP 1" as a resistant-on-par genotype; that is a different entry and is not attributed to Cotton-5 -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/377961486_Evaluation_of_Cotton_Gossypium_hirsutum_L_VarietiesGenotypes_for_Jassid_Amrasca_biguttula_biguttula_Ishida_Resistance_under_Rainfed_Conditions

The only AICRP-related hits (2024-25 annual report, 2022-23 report listing) do not name this variety in the retrieved text -- https://cicr.org.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/AICRP-2024-25-final-1.pdf ; https://www.scribd.com/document/673900719/AICRP-AR-2022-23

The institution in the input record (Regional Agricultural Research Station, Lam, ANGRAU) is not confirmed by any retrieved page for this variety. The Wikipedia page on Kaderbad Ravindranath describes ANGRAU cotton breeding, but it names other varieties and does not mention Cotton-5, so it is not attributed -- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaderbad_Ravindranath

agronomic_details.field_trials: (1) Plant growth regulator trial under high-density planting of LHDP-1 (pre-release) at Lam: mepiquat chloride 50 ppm applied at 45 and 75 DAS improved growth and yield. (3) The UAS Raichur AICRP profile reports seed cotton yield of 28-30 q/ha, GOT 37-38%, span length 27-28 mm and duration 145-150 days for 'LHDP 1' (name variant). The AICRP profile also records approval at the CVRC meeting at the AICRP on Cotton Annual Group Meeting, 30-31 May 2019. Tolerant to jassids (pest tolerance, listed here because the source groups it with resistance traits) -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf
No evidence found for drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence tolerance. The ANGRAU sheet only describes irrigated conditions, and the HDPS trial page did not report stress responses.

DISEASE AND PEST
Resistant to bacterial leaf blight (BLB) and grey mildew -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf
Tolerant to jassids (leafhopper) -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
Crop duration 145-155 days, kharif season, potential yield 25-28 q/ha, irrigated South Zone, short compact plant type (100-110 cm) with synchronous maturity, recommended for high-density planting at 60 cm x 15 cm -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf
Ginning out turn 38.6% and upper half mean length 28 mm -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf
Release year listed as 2018 on the ANGRAU sheet, which conflicts with the 2020-11-09 date in the input. A UAS Raichur AICRP profile says it was approved at the CVRC meeting at the AICRP on Cotton Annual Group Meeting, 30-31 May 2019 -- https://aiccip.cicr.org.in/SZ-KA-UASraichur.html
Seed cotton yield 28-30 q/ha, GOT 37-38%, span length 27-28 mm, duration 145-150 days, reported for "LHDP 1" (a name variant; the page does not state the full name) -- https://aiccip.cicr.org.in/SZ-KA-UASraichur.html
Plant growth regulator trial under high-density planting of LHDP-1 (pre-release) at Lam, with mepiquat chloride 50 ppm at 45 and 75 DAS improving growth and yield; a related trial was run at RARS Warangal in kharif 2022 -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/354528102_Influence_of_plant_growth_regulators_in_cotton_under_HDPS
Note: the ANGRAU sheet's entry also contains LAHB Cotton-1 data (an interspecific hybrid). Those data were excluded because they refer to a different variety.

GENETICS AND QTL
Pedigree: L 762 x G Cot 100 (conflicts with "Not specified" in the input), breeding method listed as pedigree method -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf
No evidence found for QTL, marker or molecular studies on this variety.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
Developing institution: ANGRAU, Regional Agricultural Research Station, Lam (Guntur), as the input states. The ANGRAU sheet and the AICRP profile both place the variety in the ANGRAU/Lam programme -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf ; https://aiccip.cicr.org.in/SZ-KA-UASraichur.html
No evidence found naming the lead breeder or scientist for LHDP Cotton-1. The UAS Raichur profile (Dr. Shivanand Hanchinal, Entomology) says he contributed to the variety's approval and publications, but he is a pathology/entomology scientist and no breeder role is stated, so he is not recorded here as breeder -- https://aiccip.cicr.org.in/SZ-KA-UASraichur.html
Other cotton-breeding results retrieved (Kaderbad Ravindranath's ANGRAU varieties) name other varieties and were excluded.

CONTACT DETAILS
No evidence found. No breeder contact, institute contact page or Lam station email/phone was returned for this variety. An unrelated Bt-cotton paper from RARS Lam, Guntur gives the address "Guntur, 522034" but does not name LHDP Cotton-1, so it is not attributed here -- https://www.indianjournals.com/article/apps-18-2-006

PUBLICATIONS
No evidence found for peer-reviewed papers or theses on this variety beyond the following:
Authors not shown in retrieved text (year not shown). Influence of plant growth regulators in cotton under high density planting system. ResearchGate -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/354528102_Influence_of_plant_growth_regulators_in_cotton_under_HDPS
Shivanand Hanchinal (profile, 2022). Research achievements and variety approval record, UAS Raichur AICRP cotton centre page -- https://aiccip.cicr.org.in/SZ-KA-UASraichur.html (this is a scientist profile, not a publication)

SEED AVAILABILITY
No evidence found. No NSC, State Seed Corporation, KVK, SAU or dealer listing for LHDP Cotton-1 or "LHDP Cotton - 1" was returned. The Seednet portal page was not retrieved. The results were seed vendors for other cotton types (heirloom, ornamental) and were excluded.

RECOMMENDED STATES
No evidence found naming Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka or Tamil Nadu for this variety. The ANGRAU sheet states only "South Zone of India under irrigated situations" -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/CropVarities/Cotton.pdf
The input state list is therefore not verified by any retrieved source.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
CROSS-CHECK WARNING: The variety record conflicts with itself. The release minutes say crop "millet", but the Seednet crop field says "COTTON (KAPAS)". The evidence below shows Mahanandi (SiA 3159) is a foxtail millet (Setaria italica) line from ANGRAU's RARS Nandyal, not cotton. Treat the Seednet crop entry as probably wrong until it is verified.

NAME MAPPING: Both "Mahanandi" (variety_name) and "MAHANANDI" (seednet_variety_name) are used. All evidence below refers to Mahanandi, also written SiA 3159, a foxtail millet variety. No search returned a cotton variety called Mahanandi. The cotton hits (ANGRAU cotton breeders, Narasimha, BT cotton) are unrelated.

Search budget note: all four searches were used. Searches 1 to 3 were partly wasted on the "Mahanandi" name collision (the Mahanandi village, a recipe blog, and a retail product page). Seed availability was not searched.

STRESS TOLERANCE -- Foxtail millet is described as drought tolerant at crop level, with no Mahanandi-specific data (heat, salinity, flood, submergence not found) -- https://en.vikaspedia.in/viewcontent/agriculture/crop-production/package-of-practices/cereals-and-millets/foxtail-millet?lgn=en
Mahanandi-specific stress tolerance: No evidence found.

DISEASE AND PEST -- RARS Nandyal screened 17 foxtail millet genotypes for leaf blast and rust over two years. Mahanandi/SiA 3159 is not confirmed among the entries in the abstract -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/363579924_Evaluation_of_foxtail_millet_genotypes_for_blast_and_rust_diseases_under_field_conditions
Mahanandi-specific disease or pest resistance: No evidence found.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS -- SiA 3159 was advanced to All India Coordinated Trials in 2018-19, with a yield of 4.66 t/ha in the entry report -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/Publications/Annual%20Report%20%20-%202018-2019%20(1).pdf
SiA 3159 was the best standard check in a 40-accession study at RARS Nandyal (superior in productive tillers, panicle length, photosynthesis, transpiration, chlorophyll fluorescence, harvest index) -- https://sasapjas.org/studies-on-genetic-variability-and-genetic-parameters-for-grain-yield-and-its-components-in-foxtail-millet-setaria-italica-l-p-beauv/
A 2019 Rewa (JNKVV) trial reported SiA-3159 with the highest ear length and grain yield per plant among 22 genotypes. This was a multi-location check, not a Mahanandi-specific release trial -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/370843713_Cultivation_of_Foxtail_Millet_in_India
Mahanandi-specific national multi-location yield data beyond the above: No evidence found.

GENETICS AND QTL -- A 2023 Frontiers study characterised 20 foxtail millet landraces with SSD-derived lines and four released cultivars obtained from RARS Nandyal. The paper's abstract does not confirm whether Mahanandi is one of the four -- https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/genetics/articles/10.3389/fgene.2023.1052575/full
Parentage, pedigree, QTL and marker data specific to Mahanandi: No evidence found.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION -- Institution: Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU), with the Regional Agricultural Research Station (RARS), Nandyal, Kurnool district, Andhra Pradesh. This is the station the evidence points to for SiA 3159 -- https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Foxtail-millet-Seed-varieties-from-RARS-Nandyal-Andhra-Pradesh_tbl2_334480467
Named lead breeder for Mahanandi/SiA 3159: No evidence found. Scientists named in the foxtail millet paper (Sai Ram, Naik, Narasimhulu, Venkatesh Babu, Reddi Sekhar) and in the blast/rust paper (Munirathnam, Venkataramanamma, Anusha) are associated with RARS Nandyal but are not confirmed as breeders of Mahanandi -- https://sasapjas.org/studies-on-genetic-variability-and-genetic-parameters-for-grain-yield-and-its-components-in-foxtail-millet-setaria-italica-l-p-beauv/ ; https://www.researchgate.net/publication/363579924_Evaluation_of_foxtail_millet_genotypes_for_blast_and_rust_diseases_under_field_conditions
Release/notification details for the 2022-10-26 date: No evidence found. The 2019-20 ANGRAU report lists foxtail millet releases SiA 3222 and SiA 3223 but does not name SiA 3159 as a release -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/Publications/ANGRAU-AR-2019-20-Final_pdf.pdf

CONTACT DETAILS -- No breeder contact found.
Institute contact (RARS Nandyal): Regional Agricultural Research Station, Nandyal -- 518 502 (Annual Report 2018-19). A different source gives "Nandyal-518 503, Kurnool District". Postal code conflict unresolved. -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/Publications/Annual%20Report%20%20-%202018-2019%20(1).pdf ; https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Foxtail-millet-Seed-varieties-from-RARS-Nandyal-Andhra-Pradesh_tbl2_334480467
University headquarters: village Lam, Guntur, Andhra Pradesh (Wikipedia summary). Official email and phone: No evidence found. -- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Acharya_N._G._Ranga_Agricultural_University
Agricultural College, Mahanandi (a separate college, Nandyal district, 518 502) is not the breeding station: No direct evidence it breeds SiA 3159 -- https://www.agcmnd.in/

PUBLICATIONS
Uppala Sai Ram, B. Santhosh Kumar Naik, R. Narasimhulu, D. Venkatesh Babu, M. Reddi Sekhar (year not shown). Studies on Genetic Variability and Genetic Parameters for Grain Yield and Its Components in Foxtail Millet (Setaria italica (L.) P. Beauv.). Journal: SASAP/JAS -- https://sasapjas.org/studies-on-genetic-variability-and-genetic-parameters-for-grain-yield-and-its-components-in-foxtail-millet-setaria-italica-l-p-beauv/
P. Munirathnam, K. Venkataramanamma, A. Anusha (year not shown). Evaluation of foxtail millet genotypes for blast and rust diseases under field conditions. Journal/report not shown -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/363579924_Evaluation_of_foxtail_millet_genotypes_for_blast_and_rust_diseases_under_field_conditions
Authors not shown (2023). Molecular genetics and phenotypic assessment of foxtail millet (Setaria italica (L.) P. Beauv.) landraces. Frontiers in Genetics -- DOI 10.3389/fgene.2023.1052575
ANGRAU Annual Report 2018-19 (ANGRAU, 2019). AICRP entry SiA 3159 -- https://angrau.ac.in/downloads/Publications/Annual%20Report%20%20-%202018-2019%20(1).pdf
KrishiKosh, ICAR and AICRP Small Millets theses or reports: not searched (search budget exhausted).

SEED AVAILABILITY -- Not searched; the fourth search was used for breeder information. Note: a retail listing for "Mahanandi Foxtail Millet Korralu" is a consumer grain product, not certified seed -- https://navafresh.com/products/mahanandi-foxtail-millet-4kgpack-of-8-each-pocket-500gramskorralumilletsfoxtail-millet
NSC, State Seed Corporation, KVK, SAU or dealer stock for seed: Not searched.

RECOMMENDED STATES -- Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, under the foxtail millet variety list from the Indian Institute of Millets Research (via Vikaspedia) -- https://en.vikaspedia.in/viewcontent/agriculture/crop-production/package-of-practices/cereals-and-millets/foxtail-millet?lgn=en
Karnataka recommendation for Mahanandi: not listed in that source.

Key open items for the record: (1) correct the Seednet crop field from cotton to foxtail millet, and verify the variety code SiA 3159 against the release notification; (2) confirm the 2022-10-26 release date and the parentage; (3) obtain the lead breeder name and official RARS Nandyal contact from ANGRAU; (4) run the seed-availability search.

pest_resistance.summary: Sucking pests: high tolerance is claimed in retail listings (Rallis and Badikheti pages), with no quantified or field-scored data found. Bollworm: a Bollgard II (Bt) trait is named in listings, and the BG-II technology is referenced in the Badikheti FAQ. No quantified resistance levels or IPM data found.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Retail listings say the hybrid is tolerant of cotton leaf curl virus (CLCV), which is the main stress claim in the sources. -- https://www.rallis.com/india-business/seeds-cn/pravir-(MC5403) (evidence refers to "Pravir (MC5403)", matched on code MC5403; no official Rallis technical sheet found)
- A second retail page repeats the CLCV and sucking-pest tolerance claims for "Tata Pravir (MC5403)". -- https://www.kisanshop.in/product/tata-pravir-mc5403-bg-ii-hybrid-cotton-seeds (evidence refers to "Tata Pravir (MC5403)")
- Drought, heat, salinity, flood and submergence tolerance: No evidence found. Searched in the variety query; the pages returned only sales listings.

DISEASE AND PEST
- Listings describe high sucking-pest tolerance and CLCV tolerance, with a Bollgard II (Bt) trait for bollworm. -- https://www.rallis.com/india-business/seeds-cn/pravir-(MC5403) ; https://www.badikheti.com/cotton-seeds/pdp/tata-pravir-mc5403-bg-ii-hybrid-cotton-seeds-kapas-ke-beej/xnz1g6sy (the BG-II Bt technology is named in the FAQ answer)
- Quantified resistance levels, field-scored tolerance, or IPM data: No evidence found.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Listed crop duration is 150–165 days, with boll weight of 4.5–6 g, and yield of 12–16 quintals per acre. These figures come from a retailer, not from a trial or an official release. -- https://krushidukan.bharatagri.com/en/products/tata-pravir-mc-5403-cotton-seeds-sumitomo-kemstar-insecticide-combo
- Sowing windows conflict between sources. One retailer gives April–June with 3 ft × 1.5 ft spacing; another gives May–July kharif and November–January rabi, with 75–90 cm × 30–45 cm spacing. -- https://krushidukan.bharatagri.com/en/products/tata-pravir-mc-5403-cotton-seeds-sumitomo-kemstar-insecticide-combo ; https://www.badikheti.com/cotton-seeds/pdp/tata-pravir-mc5403-bg-ii-hybrid-cotton-seeds-kapas-ke-beej/xnz1g6sy
- Field trial or multi-location yield data for this variety: No evidence found.

GENETICS AND QTL
- Parentage, pedigree, and marker or QTL information: No evidence found. The "Not specified" parentage was not contradicted; no source named parent lines.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- The commercial marketer is Rallis India Limited (Tata-branded), which sells the product as Pravir (MC5403). Breeder names and the developing station: No evidence found. -- https://www.rallis.com/india-business/seeds-cn/pravir-(MC5403)
- Search for named breeders returned only unrelated US patent records (DP, PX, 18R, NG cultivars), which were discarded.

CONTACT DETAILS
- Institute-level contact details (email, phone, postal address, or Rallis contact page): No evidence found. No Rallis or Tata contact page appeared in any result.

PUBLICATIONS
- No evidence found. The heterosis paper on Bt BGII upland cotton (https://www.researchgate.net/publication/389601710_Assessment_of_heterosis_and_combining_ability_for_fibre_yield_its_contributing_and_quality_traits_in_Bt_BGII_upland_cotton_Gossypium_hirsutum_L) and the pink bollworm BGII survival study (https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s41938-021-00393-7) do not name MC5403, so they were discarded. The GEAC Bt hybrid list (http://www.geacindia.gov.in/resource-documents/approved-products/Final_commercially_approved.pdf) returned no MC5403 entry in the snippet.

SEED AVAILABILITY
- Pack size listed as 475 g, sold through Rallis-branded online retail. -- https://www.rallis.com/india-business/seeds-cn/pravir-(MC5403)
- The kisanshop listing is marked out of stock for 475 g. -- https://www.kisanshop.in/product/tata-pravir-mc5403-bg-ii-hybrid-cotton-seeds
- A badikheti listing sells the seed online, but its price fields are garbled and cannot be verified. -- https://www.badikheti.com/cotton-seeds/pdp/tata-pravir-mc5403-bg-ii-hybrid-cotton-seeds-kapas-ke-beej/xnz1g6sy
- A Krushi Dukan combo listing is marked out of stock. -- https://krushidukan.bharatagri.com/en/products/tata-pravir-mc-5403-cotton-seeds-sumitomo-kemstar-insecticide-combo
- NSC, state seed corporation, KVK, SAU, or other government seed sales: No evidence found. Seednet portal listing for "MC5403 BGII" or "COTTON (KAPAS)": No evidence found; the Seednet portal was not returned by any search.

RECOMMENDED STATES
- Rallis and retail sources list Haryana and Punjab as the sales states. -- https://www.rallis.com/india-business/seeds-cn/pravir-(MC5403) ; https://www.kisanshop.in/product/tata-pravir-mc5403-bg-ii-hybrid-cotton-seeds
- Conflict: a retail listing for "Tata Pravir MC-5403" names a much wider set of states (Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu). This is unverified and conflicts with the CSC Punjab entry. -- https://krushidukan.bharatagri.com/en/products/tata-pravir-mc-5403-cotton-seeds-sumitomo-kemstar-insecticide-combo
- CSC release minutes for MC5403 BGII (release date 2020-11-09): No evidence found. Official release notification or the national seed gazette entry: No evidence found.
