heat.details: Not found in searched sources. No heat tolerance data for this variety were returned.

salinity.details: Supplied variety record (not a digest URL): screened in vitro at the seedling stage by a laboratory-based technique and scored 1 (resistant) at one EC level and 3 (moderately resistant) at a second EC level, with growth and tillering nearly normal relative to the resistant check AT401. The EC values in the record are garbled and could not be read with confidence. Adaptation is stated as the coastal saline tract of West Bengal up to soil EC 6 dS/m, with yield of around 5.0 t/ha up to soil EC 6 dS/m. The search digest found no independent confirmation for this variety. A plant-science paper names a salt-tolerant genotype 'Chinsurah Nona I' in a saline bio-inoculant study, but the digest states it does not name the released variety or IET code and was not attributed. The level is rated medium because the evidence rests on a single supplied record and is unverified.

The digest itself returned no disease evidence for this variety.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
I could not finish the research. The search tool hit its usage limit partway through, after my first batch of four searches had already returned results. A second attempt to read the full page contents was blocked, so I only have partial snippets from the first batch. I also did not run the Seednet-name query separately. The findings below are limited to what the snippets showed.

EVIDENCE DIGEST: DRR Dhan 55 (Seednet: DRR Dhan-55 (RP 5591-123-16-2) IET 26194), Rice

STRESS TOLERANCE -- Telangana Today snippet says DRR Dhan 53, 54, 55 and 56 were released by ICAR-IIRR and are described as resistant to something, but the snippet was cut off before naming the stress. Needs the full article. -- https://telanganatoday.com/icar-iirr-releases-four-new-rice-varieties

DISEASE AND PEST -- No evidence found. The Telangana Today snippet suggests a resistance trait but does not name it. Not verified.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS -- ICAR-IIRR variety page describes DRR Dhan 55 as an early direct-seeded aerobic variety with medium duration of about 125 days. -- https://www.icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/institute-research/institue-technologies-developed?id=202

GENETICS AND QTL (parentage, breeding code, method) -- A ResearchGate paper on DRR Dhan 70 describes DRR Dhan 55 [IET 26194 (RP 5591-123-16-2)] as an aerobic rice variety developed from MTU1010 / IR79915-B-83-4-3. The page is about DRR Dhan 70, so this is a reference to DRR Dhan 55, not a primary description of it. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/382617803_DRR_Dhan_70-IET_29415_-_An_Aerobic_Rice_Variety

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION -- ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (ICAR-IIRR) is named as the releasing institution by the Telangana Today article. No individual breeder name was found. -- https://telanganatoday.com/icar-iirr-releases-four-new-rice-varieties

CONTACT DETAILS -- No breeder contact found. The ICAR-IIRR variety page is the institute source; I did not retrieve its contact page, email, phone or address. Not verified.

PUBLICATIONS -- Snippets show only mentions of DRR Dhan 55 inside papers on other varieties (DRR Dhan 54 and DRR Dhan 70 on ResearchGate). These are not dedicated studies of DRR Dhan 55, so I have not listed them as publications. No dedicated paper, AICRP report or KrishiKosh thesis was found in the snippets. Not searched to completion (the research-query results were cut short).

SEED AVAILABILITY -- No evidence found in the retrieved snippets. The ICAR-IIRR variety page is the only source that could be relevant here, but I did not see seed-supplier details. Not searched to completion.

RECOMMENDED STATES -- The release name and state list ("Bihar and Chhattisgarh") were given in the brief and not verified by a source in this session. The Telangana Today article is about the four-variety release but its snippet did not state states. Not verified.

Gaps to close in a follow-up session: full text of the Telangana Today and ICAR-IIRR pages (stress and disease traits, release notification, states), the Seednet portal page for DRR Dhan-55, ICAR-IIRR contact page, KrishiKosh and journal searches for dedicated DRR Dhan 55 studies, and seed-supplier searches.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: Dehangi (rice, variety code IC574471)

Name note: The CSC name "Dehangi" and the Seednet name are both unconfirmed. I ran the searches on "Dehangi" alone, so every finding below refers to the name Dehangi. The Seednet listing was not separately checked. The search tool hit its usage limit after four searches, so I could not re-open the full text of the two pages that mention Dehangi. Findings are limited to what the search snippets showed.

STRESS TOLERANCE: No evidence found. The snippets did not mention drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence tolerance for Dehangi.

DISEASE AND PEST: A disease-reaction table lists Dehangi among recommended rice varieties of Assam, but the snippet did not show which ratings belong to Dehangi -- https://diragri.assam.gov.in/sites/default/files/swf_utility_folder/departments/diragri_medhassu_in_oid_4/portlet/level_2/11(A).2.pdf

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS: The Assam Kharif package of practices (2015) includes Dehangi in its list of recommended rice varieties. The snippet did not give yield, duration or management details for Dehangi -- https://diragri.assam.gov.in/sites/default/files/swf_utility_folder/departments/diragri_medhassu_in_oid_4/portlet/level_2/11(A).2.pdf

GENETICS AND QTL (genes, parentage, breeding-line codes, breeding method, genome resources): A 2023 review, "Hundred years of rice research in Assam," mentions Dehangi alongside the code "AAUDR 9313-14-3". The snippet is garbled, so I cannot confirm that this code belongs to Dehangi or what the parentage is -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/393846178_Hundred_years_of_rice_research_in_Assam
Variety code IC574471 did not appear in any snippet. Parentage: unknown.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION: The review is attributed to Safiqul Hussain and others, and carries the Assam Agricultural University (AAU) Assam Rice Research Institute copyright at Titabar, Jorhat. This shows the AAU rice research system is involved, but it does not name the breeder of Dehangi -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/393846178_Hundred_years_of_rice_research_in_Assam
The institution named in the record, the Regional Agricultural Research Station (RARS), was not confirmed as the developer.

CONTACT DETAILS: No breeder contact found. Institute-level address found on the same review's copyright line: Assam Agricultural University, Assam Rice Research Institute, Titabar-785630, Jorhat, Assam -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/393846178_Hundred_years_of_rice_research_in_Assam
No email or phone number was found. The AAU official website was not reached.

PUBLICATIONS:
Hussain, S. and others (2023). Hundred years of rice research in Assam. Publication on ResearchGate (exact journal or report not confirmed) -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/393846178_Hundred_years_of_rice_research_in_Assam
No peer-reviewed paper, KrishiKosh thesis or AICRP report specifically on Dehangi was found.

SEED AVAILABILITY: No evidence found. The search returned no seed-sale listing from NSC, the Assam state seed agency, a KVK, AAU or a dealer for Dehangi.

RECOMMENDED STATES: Assam. The Assam Kharif package of practices lists Dehangi as a recommended rice variety -- https://diragri.assam.gov.in/sites/default/files/swf_utility_folder/departments/diragri_medhassu_in_oid_4/portlet/level_2/11(A).2.pdf

YEAR OF RELEASE: Unknown. Not found in any result.
